Jordan (Sales): Heads-up — MerchantCo wants a quick POC evidence bundle: SOC 2 excerpt, signed pen-test attestation, redacted KMS custody flow, and a short-lived private dataroom. They've asked whether a 2-week Dedicated pilot changes the POC pricing vs hosted credits. Need turnaround by Friday.

Alex Chen: We can provide a redacted SOC2 excerpt and our pen-test attestation template. For a signed letter we need the NDA + a named signatory (name/title/email). We DO NOT provide raw vuln exports or private keys.

Marta L: Dataroom ops: use the assurance intake form and attach NDA. Link: https://redwood.example.com/assurance/dataroom-request. Include TTL, customer contact, and requested artifact list. We will watermark artifacts and enable access logging.

Jordan (Sales): Can you paste a quick email template for security so I can send it to the customer's procurement?

Alex Chen: Yep — paste this to security@redwood.com or into the intake form:

```
To: security@redwood.com
Subject: MerchantCo - Dataroom + Signed Attestation Request
Customer: MerchantCo
Contact: security@merchantco.com
Signatory: (full name, title, email)
NDA: attached
Artifacts: SOC2 excerpt (redacted), pen-test attestation (signed), KMS custody flow (redacted)
TTL: 14 days
```

Sam R: Pricing note: Hosted POC = billed to free credits or pay-as-you-go. Dedicated pilot requires a short reserved pool and a signed commitment; finance can prorate but needs approval for <30 day terms. I can run a quick 2-week Dedicated estimate and post it here in ~90m.

Marta L: Security caveats: network diagrams must not show internal IPs. KMS flow ok if redacted. If MerchantCo requests raw scan artifacts, escalate to legal.

Security Ops: Ticket created: SEC-2026-998 — dataroom intake received pending NDA. SLA: 1 business day after intake.

Jordan (Sales): Thanks — I'll send NDA + signatory now and flag procurement timeline. @Sam R please drop the Dedicated estimate when ready.

Sam R: Will post the estimate in this thread in ~90m.
